component.name: Zero
component.summary: Post-quantum end-to-end encrypted messenger with zero user identifiers

description.p: Zero is an open-source, post-quantum end-to-end encrypted messenger with no phone numbers, no email addresses, and no persistent user IDs.

ul.li: End-to-end encrypted messaging combining Curve448 and sntrup761 post-quantum key encapsulation on every ratchet step.
Unidirectional pairwise SMP queues with fixed 16 KB traffic padding and optional 2-hop onion routing.
Encrypted file and media transfers up to 1 GiB via chunked XFTP relays.
One-time invitation links, 4-word contact phrases, 6-digit in-person pairing codes, and QR verification.
End-to-end encrypted WebRTC audio and video calls with TURN relay privacy options.
SQLCipher 256-bit AES local storage encryption with full offline device sovereignty.

description.p: - Initial v1.0.0 open-source release across macOS, Windows, Linux, Android (APK), CLI, and iOS/mobile store review builds
- Argon2id PoW profile calibration across mobile and desktop clients
- Broker deep-link validation and automated regression test coverage
- Desktop focus handling and notification activation fixes
- Broker rate limiting and strict security headers
- Reproducible core builds pinned to GHC 9.6.3
- Initial Compose Multiplatform desktop app release (Linux, macOS, Windows)
- XFTP encrypted file transfers and remote device control over C11 JNI bridge
